result:
Looking at this qlang documentation and the tasks, I'll work through each query carefully, focusing on the data transformations described.

N1: Filter active users with non-null string emails, extract domain, lowercase, deduplicate, sort:
```
/data/users | filter ~(if /active ~((at :email | type | eq ::string)) ~(false)) | * (/email | split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort
```

N2: Filter paid orders, compute amounts, sum per customer, top 2 by total:
```
filter ~((/status | lower | eq "paid")) | * (:order / | {:customer (/order/customer/name) :amount ((/order/lines * (mul /qty /unit_price) | sum) | sub ~(/order/discount | coalesce 0))}) | :orders / | (distinct ~/customer) * (:customer / | {:customer / :total (/orders | filter ~(/customer | eq customer) | * /amount | sum | round 2)}) | sort ~(/total) | reverse | take 2
```

N3: Open issues counted by assignee, with null/missing as "unassigned":
```
filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~((at /assignee/login | coalesce "unassigned")) | * count
```

N4: Dependencies + devDependencies, filter for '^' versions, sorted names:
```
(/dependencies | coalesce {}) | union (/devDependencies | coalesce {}) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys | sort
```

N5: Service analysis - enabled count, distinct ports, total replicas:
```
/services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) | :enabled / | {:enabledCount (/enabled | count) :ports (/enabled | vals * (at :port) | filter ~(type | ne ::null) | distinct | sort) :totalReplicas (/enabled | vals * (/replicas | coalesce 1) | sum)}
```

N6: ERROR log entries by service, top 2:
```
lines | filter ~(ne "") | * (split " " | {:level (/1 | lower) :service (/2 | drop 1 | take (count | sub 1))}) | filter ~(/level | eq "error") | groupBy ~/service | * ({:service (first | /service) :count (count)}) | sort ~(/count) | reverse | take 2
```

N7: CSV revenue by region (case-insensitive), rounded:
```
lines | filter ~(ne "") | * (split "," | {:region (/0 | lower) :qty (/2 | if ~(ne "") ~(parseJson) ~(null)) :price (/3 | if ~(ne "") ~(parseJson) ~(null))}) | filter ~(if (/qty | type | eq ::null) ~(false) ~(if (/price | type | eq ::null) ~(false) ~(true))) | * {:region /region :revenue (mul /qty /price | round 2)} | groupBy ~/region | * (sum | round 2)
```

N8: Users with login but no logout (case-insensitive):
```
:events / | distinct * /user | sort | filter ~(:user / | if (/events | filter ~(/user | eq user) | * (/type | lower) | contains "login") ~(if (/events | filter ~(/user | eq user) | * (/type | lower) | contains "logout") ~(false) ~(true)) ~(false))
```

N9: Average salary per department (excluding null/missing):
```
filter ~(at :salary | type | ne ::null) | groupBy ~/dept | * (* /salary | :sals / | /sals | sum | div (/sals | count) | round 1)
```

N10: Distinct tags from articles, lowercased and trimmed:
```
lines | filter ~(ne "") | * (split ":" | last | split "," | * lower) | flat | filter ~(ne "") | distinct | sort
```

N11: Words with count > 1, case-insensitive, sorted by count desc:
```
["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","apple","date"] | * (lower) | groupBy / | filter ~(count | gt 1) | * ({:word (first) :count (count)}) | sort ~(/count) | reverse
```

N12: Top 3 releases by downloads, excluding drafts/prereleases:
```
/releases | filter ~(if /draft ~(false) ~(if /prerelease ~(false) ~(true))) | * {:tag /tag_name :downloads (/assets | * (at :download_count | coalesce 0) | sum)} | sort ~(/downloads) | reverse | take 3
```

N13: Tools category products analysis:
```
filter ~((/category | lower | eq "tools")) | :tools / | {:count (/tools | count) :allPriced (/tools | every ~(if (/price | type | ne ::null) ~(gt 0) ~(false))) :inStockNames (/tools | filter ~(/stock | gt 0) | * /name | sort)}
```

N14: Pinned pip requirements only:
```
lines | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(startsWith "-" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "#" | first | split "==" | {:name (/0 | lower) :version /1}) | indexBy ~/name | * /version
```
